title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: charger_common battery-sync glue verified function-level vs stock (Renode 1.17 cortex-m55)

method.design: stock bodies run in place (0x4ACE10..0x4AD7xx); reconstructed C linked into ITCM. Intra-module calls resolve within each variant (stock-for-stock, C-for-C), so each test exercises the function plus its in-module callees. Cross-module callees patched to stubs at their stock addresses for both variants: audio_uart_device_role_get (seeded return), audio_uart_request_send (logs app/len/payload), audio_queue_copy_bytes (memcpy), audio_uart_buffer_zero, osMutexAcquire/Release/Delete (osOK), CB_CHG_NotifyBatInfo (logs event+value), CB_CHG_DeinitBatInfoCallbacks, elog. The charge-sync RAM globals (STATE 0x20073b30, LOCAL 0x20074104, mutex handle 0x20074370, flags 0x20074f97/98/99, poll counters 0x20074f1a/1c) and g2_charger_telemetry (0x20073b18) are seeded identically before each test and diffed after.
method.compare: per test: CB_CHG_NotifyBatInfo and audio_uart_request_send call traces (event/value and the built sync-message payload), all seeded RAM globals, caller output struct, and return value (void ignored).
method.inputs: 25 randomized cases per function x 11 functions = 275, run stock vs C, with audio_log_flags()=0 and =7.

result.note: 10 phantom parser segments (indices >=275, from logged content words matching the 0xA5 marker) ignored; all 275 real cases present with both variants and equal.

notes: Function-level equivalence only. No sources.json/linker/build changes; no git; no flash.
reverification_notes: Re-verified under the final arg-comparing + VFP-aware harness and the global-merge-off build (-fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false); 0 mismatches in the 2026-11-22 19:12 CST full batch re-run.
